clinical_stage: Stage IVA (Pleural and Contralateral Pulmonary Nodules)

prior_lines_of_therapy.discontinuation_reason: Acquired resistance with new pleural lesions (RECIST PD)

active_comorbidities_and_toxicities: Prior Grade 1 Acneiform Rash on Erlotinib
clinical_note_summary: 69-year-old male with Stage IVA EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma progressing after 16 months on first-line Erlotinib. Repeat biopsy and ctDNA NGS confirm acquired EGFR p.T790M gatekeeper mutation alongside baseline EGFR p.L858R. eGFR is 42.0 mL/min, ECOG 1.
